title: More Villager Information - MVI
description: More Villager Information in form of Counters and Nametags
body:
Gives you more information on villagers. Adds breeding cooldown, time until a baby villager grows up, time until a zombie villager is successfully healed, and a checkmark above cured villagers. All 4 features are toggleable using modmenu. 

Every feature is still visible in F1, except the Cured-Checkmark, since it is part of the Villager Name Tag. I wont fix that btw.

The mod does NOT work on Servers that dont have the Mod installed. It is designed for Singleplayer Use. Not fixing that either btw

Ahh also this Mod is made with AI. I am not the real creator of this mod, i just gave AI a description, and it started its thing. I do not want any credit for this mod, which is also why i made a new account. If you have questions/issues, please ask in a Discord server that is dedicated to Fabric Loader. I will not be answering questions or fixing errors myself as i want to stay anonymous and dont want this mod to be associated to the real me.
